753:t_146:3.en:
$$ロラン$$
「$$ディアナ$$ endured that loneliness and sorrow...! She never smiled and delighted in it like you!」

753:t_146:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「She is only human, after all. I have become God and transcended even that!」

753:t_146:5.en:
$$ロラン$$
「If becoming God means losing your human heart, then I reject the very existence of God...!」

753:t_146:6.en:
$$ロラン$$
「To protect this world that $$ディアナ$$ and my lady taught me to love... $$アドヴェント#pilot$$, I'll stop you!!」

753:t_147:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「It is a shame, $$アムロ$$. If someone like you had been born sooner, the universe might have been saved.」

753:t_147:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「It's not too late...! If we defeat you and stop the universe's great collapse, humanity can move toward the future again!」

753:t_147:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「That is impossible. For a start, you cannot stop the universe's collapse.」

753:t_147:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Even if you did, a world without me would be swallowed by chaos. Humanity would only head toward self-destruction.」

753:t_147:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「A self-obsessed would-be god is even harder to deal with than an intellectual revolutionary!」

753:t_147:6.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Don't talk about your self-serving delusions as if they're facts...! Humanity isn't as foolish as you think!」

753:t_147:7.en:
$$アムロ$$
「We'll prove it! We'll defeat you, the obstacle in our way, and show the path toward the future!!」

753:t_148:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$ハサウェイ$$... You have been unfortunate.」

753:t_148:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You were born $$ブライト・ノア$$'s son, drawn to $$クェス$$, a girl tossed about by $$アムロ$$ and $$シャア$$, and plunged into war to save her...」

753:t_148:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「But those days of unwanted battle are over. I shall save you.」

753:t_148:4.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「I didn't ask for your help! I'm fighting of my own free will!」

753:t_148:5.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Sure, I started out fighting to save $$クェス$$. But now I intend to save many more people, not just her!」

753:t_148:6.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「So I won't lose, especially to someone as selfish as you!!」

753:t_149:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「What makes you God!? Don't call yourself that when you smile while watching the universe perish!」

753:t_149:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You are mistaken, $$カミーユ$$. It is precisely because I am God that I can endure this heartbreak.」

753:t_149:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「And with your memories, I shall depart for a new world... to guide it in the right direction this time.」

753:t_149:3.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You have no right to decide what's right for the world! The people living in it decide that!」

753:t_149:4.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「What you're doing is selfish hypocrisy! Understand that!」

753:t_149:5.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You are the one who must understand, $$カミーユ$$. I have the right and the power to decide everything!」

753:t_149:6.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Then we'll break that power! We mere humans will!」

753:t_149:7.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「And we'll make you understand, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! Humanity still needs a future!!」

753:t_150:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Poor $$フォウ$$, with no past... I shall save you.」

753:t_150:1.en:
$$フォウ$$
「You don't understand anything! I want a future, not a past!」

753:t_150:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Then I shall give you that future, as a new life in a new world.」

753:t_150:3.en:
$$フォウ$$
「You still don't understand! The future isn't something someone gives you!」

753:t_150:4.en:
$$フォウ$$
「We'll seize the future with our own hands! We'll overcome the enormous wall you are!!」

753:t_151:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$! You snuff out possibility!」

753:t_151:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I shall carry humanity's possibilities to a new world. There, humans will evolve correctly this time.」

753:t_151:2.en:
$$バナージ$$
「What is correct evolution!? Do you have the right to decide that!?」

753:t_151:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I can confidently answer that I do.」

753:t_151:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「That is the resolve with which I rose as God.」

753:t_151:5.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Only humans have a god...! Their god is called possibility...!」

753:t_151:6.en:
$$バナージ$$
「If you call yourself God, our possibilities will surpass you!」

753:t_151:7.en:
$$バナージ$$
「That's what the people who entrusted us with the future wished for!!」

753:t_151:8.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You are mistaken, $$バナージ$$. The future is in my hands.」

753:t_151:9.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I'll strike down that arrogance!」

753:t_151:10.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Answer my feelings, $$ユニコーン$$! Help me surpass him and seize the future with my own hands!!」

753:t_152:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$リディ$$... You seem to have mastered the $$バンシィ$$ I gave you.」

753:t_152:1.en:
$$リディ$$
「Back then, you gave me the $$バンシィ$$ and told me about the $$御使い$$s...」

753:t_152:2.en:
$$リディ$$
「Why did you tell me the truth?」

753:t_152:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I wanted to see what would emerge if I gave you a $$ガンダム$$, a product of the civilization of fire.」

753:t_152:4.en:
$$リディ$$
「You bastard! What do you think $$バナージ$$ and I are!? We're not your toys!」

753:t_152:5.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「But you overcame those trials and gained power. I would like your gratitude for that.」

753:t_152:6.en:
$$リディ$$
「Then I'll show you that power... human power!」

753:t_152:7.en:
$$リディ$$
「Our possibilities will surpass your plans! I'll prove it!!」

753:t_153:0.en:
$$カツ$$
「I'll fight even if my opponent is God!」

753:t_153:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「That courage borders on recklessness... $$カツ$$, you are entertaining to watch.」

753:t_153:2.en:
$$カツ$$
「I know I can't defeat you unless I go that far! I'll risk my life too!」

753:t_153:3.en:
$$カツ$$
「$$サラ$$! I'll seize the future! I'll seize the future you wished for!」

753:t_154:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$エマ$$... Once the fighting ends, you will live with the one you love, won't you?」

753:t_154:1.en:
$$エマ$$
「That's exactly why I refuse to accept the universe's collapse!」

753:t_154:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Your love will be fulfilled in the new world. I guarantee it.」

753:t_154:3.en:
$$エマ$$
「I don't wish only for my own happiness! As a soldier, I have a duty to protect everyone's freedom and peace!」

753:t_154:4.en:
$$エマ$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$! You stand in the way, and I'll eliminate you!」

753:t_155:0.en:
$$ファ$$
「I have to fight... for everyone, and for the universe!」

753:t_155:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You needn't be afraid, $$ファ$$. You don't need to fight.」

753:t_155:2.en:
$$ファ$$
「Don't decide how I should live!」

753:t_155:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Your trembling voice makes that utterly unconvincing.」

753:t_155:4.en:
$$ファ$$
「I'll fight anyway! I'm a human being living in this world too!」

753:t_155:5.en:
$$ファ$$
「So I'll resist with everything I have! I want to protect the world I live in through my own strength!」

753:t_156:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You don't need to fight anymore, $$刹那$$.」

753:t_156:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「As a child, you despaired of God and clung to $$ガンダム$$. Then you surpassed $$ガンダム$$... But something still remains beyond you.」

753:t_156:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Yes. I am the very god you longed for as a child!」

753:t_156:7.en:
$$刹那$$
「If you really are God, then this time I can finally break with the very existence of God...」

753:t_156:8.en:
$$刹那$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$! You're no god! You are conflict itself!」

753:t_156:9.en:
$$刹那$$
「That's why we'll surpass you! We believe in the future beyond this fighting!」

753:t_156:10.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「That wish will never come true!」

753:t_156:11.en:
$$刹那$$
「I'll make it come true! That's what I've fought for all this time!」

753:t_156:12.en:
$$刹那$$
「I am $$刹那・Ｆ・セイエイ$$! I'm a $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ $$ガンダムマイスター$$! I'll end the fighting and open the way to the future!!」

753:t_157:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Let me reward you for carrying on your brother's name and fighting all this time.」
